## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

Fix the `--exclude` default so CI can configure exclusions through the environment.

## Changes

The pull request adds a repeatable `--exclude GLOB` option that matches file basenames and logs skipped paths in verbose mode. It also documents the flag and adds tests for parsing, file selection, and archive contents.

## Important

- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclusion default from `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE` — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude` argument, the parser returns an empty list. `.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11` requires that “Every command-line flag added under `cli/` from now on must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable”. — CI jobs that set exclusions only through the environment will still archive matching files such as `debug.log`.
